findings.defect: The draft introduces a first-person subject after the viewpoint has shifted to Won Myunghoon’s group, falsely making Taekyung the narrator of this line.
findings.rationale: The Korean is a subjectless description of Taekyung’s combat, not first-person narration.
findings.replacement: He tore through their ranks unhindered.

findings.current: “Uh, Guild Master. That’s not what I—”
findings.defect: The address changes Won’s title from CEO to Guild Master, losing the established corporate hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 대표님 addresses Won in his established role as CEO of the Star Guild.

findings.current: And you only became a ranker because of the fame you built in the entertainment industry and your incredible connections.
findings.defect: “Connections” softens and obscures the explicit accusation that Won obtained his ranker status through extensive lobbying.
findings.rationale: 로비 specifically means lobbying or influence-peddling here, a meaningful accusation about how Won secured his ranking.
findings.replacement: And your ranker status was only the result of the recognition you built in the entertainment industry and an enormous amount of lobbying.
findings.source: 랭커는 연예계 생활을 하며 쌓은 인지도와 엄청난 로비로 얻어낸 결과물이었잖아.

findings.current: It had taken only about fifteen minutes to wipe out more than fifty B-Rank monsters, the Orc Warriors.
findings.defect: “More than fifty” changes an approximate count centered on fifty into a lower-bounded quantity.
findings.rationale: 오십여 마리 means approximately fifty, not more than fifty.
findings.replacement: It had taken only about fifteen minutes to wipe out around fifty B-Rank monsters—the Orc Warriors.
findings.source: B급 몬스터인 오크 워리어 오십여 마리를 전멸시키기까지 걸린 시간은 불과 15분 남짓.

findings.current: Won Myunghoon muttered those words inwardly and gestured toward Team Leader 1.
findings.defect: A specific signal made with the eyes is changed into an unspecified physical gesture.
findings.rationale: 눈짓했다 explicitly describes giving an eye signal.
findings.replacement: Won Myunghoon muttered those words inwardly and signaled Team Leader 1 with his eyes.

findings.current: No matter how hard I try, I can only become a D-Rank Hunter… but I want you to know that I’m always cheering for you.
findings.defect: The draft implies that Im has not yet become a D-Rank Hunter, contradicting his established current rank and the source’s self-deprecating statement about his limit.
findings.rationale: D급 헌터밖에 못 되지만 describes his limited standing as a D-Rank Hunter, not a future promotion he may attain.
findings.replacement: No matter how hard I try, I’m still only a D-Rank Hunter… but I want you to know that I’m always cheering for you.
findings.source: 내가 아무리 용 써 봐야 D급 헌터밖에 못 되지만…… 항상 응원하고 있다는 것만 알아 둬.

summary: Several actionable fidelity and hierarchy issues remain.
